_comment: Servers the agent connects to. stdio servers: command + args (relative paths resolve from the repo root; 'python' means this venv's Python). Remote servers: url. Flip 'enabled' to try others.

filesystem._comment: Official reference server from github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers. Needs Node (npx).

fetch._comment: Official reference server: fetch a URL as markdown. Needs uv (uvx).
